acceptance_criteria: Design covers EXP-301, EXP-302, EXP-303 explicitly
No source implementation code in artifact
task.description: Produce implementation design for EXP-301/302/303 (Epic 3 async outbound effects). Design only, no implementation code. Cover: 1) new effects subsystem module boundaries (queue storage, worker, adapters, retry/backoff, idempotency header from effect-event-id, dead-letter path), 2) result re-entry model as effect.completed/effect.failed events with correlation_id, 3) migration path for service tasks from inline I/O to effect emit + wait + branch, including any decision-gated sync exceptions clearly marked, 4) sandbox stub executor behavior and hooks for deterministic tests, 5) touchpoints and incremental rollout plan preserving pure transition function and audit invariants.

result.summary: Type E prose design for EXP-301/302/303 (EPIC-3 async outbound effects): effects subsystem module boundaries, outbox schema, worker loop, HTTP adapter, stub executor, service task migration path with sync-exception decision gate, idempotency strategy, error taxonomy, state transitions, test strategy, and incremental rollout plan.
